name: Suno
tagline: Suno is an AI music generation platform that creates complete songs (vocals, instruments, and production) from a short text description. You describe a genre, mood, and theme, and Suno produces a radio-ready track in seconds. With tens of millions of users, it's the most popular AI music tool and has introduced a new era of accessible music creation.
